items.answer: If you cannot ~, please let me know the reason and the date you can ~.

items.answer: Payment will be made only once ~.

cover_practice.prompt: 최종 확정하다: Let's f_______ the overtime plan for next week.
비교할 수 있는: These two quotes are not c_________ because the scope is different.
서둘러 앞당기다: Can the forwarder e_______ the customs clearance?
무기한의: Workers on an i_________-term contract do not need to re-sign every year.
견적서를 받은 지 2주가 지났는데 아직 결정을 못 했습니다. (주어·동사 넣기)
cover_practice.answer: It has been two weeks since we received the quotation, and we still have not decided.

cover_practice.prompt: 금요일까지 다른 말씀이 없으면 이 일정으로 진행하겠습니다. (주어·동사 넣기)
cover_practice.answer: Unless I hear otherwise by Friday, I will go ahead with this schedule.

words.meaning: 최종 확정하다, 마무리하다 — finish / decide 대신
words.example: We need to finalize the transfer pricing file and sign it today.
words.collocations: finalize the report / finalize the details

words.meaning: (조건이 같아) 비교할 수 있는 — similar / same 대신
words.example: Please get comparable quotes for the same hard disk size.

words.meaning: (처리를) 서둘러 앞당기다 — do it fast 대신
words.example: Could you expedite the PR approval? The purchase has been waiting for weeks.
words.collocations: expedite the approval / expedite the shipment

words.meaning: 기한이 없는, 무기한의 — no end date 대신
words.example: We will change her contract to an indefinite-term contract before it ends.

patterns.pattern: We'd like to go ahead with ~, provided that ~.
patterns.meaning: ~라는 조건으로 ~을 진행하겠습니다 (OK, but ~ 대신, 조건을 붙여 승인할 때)
patterns.skeleton: We'd like to go ahead with + [명사], provided that + [주어][동사]
patterns.email: We'd like to go ahead with the new supplier, provided that the price includes the yearly check.
patterns.spoken: OK, let's go with them, as long as the yearly check is included.

patterns.pattern: It has been ~ since ~, and ~ still ~.
patterns.meaning: ~한 지 ~가 지났는데 아직 ~입니다 (It is late 대신, 재촉할 때 사실로 말하기)
patterns.skeleton: It has been + [기간] + since + [주어][동사], and + [주어] + still + [동사]
patterns.email: It has been three weeks since we submitted the PR, and it still has not been approved.
patterns.spoken: It's been three weeks, and it's still not approved.

patterns.pattern: Unless I hear otherwise by ~, I will ~.
patterns.meaning: ~까지 다른 말씀이 없으면 ~하겠습니다 (If no answer, I will ~ 대신, 기한 정하고 진행 알릴 때)
patterns.skeleton: Unless I hear otherwise + by [시각], + I will + [동사]
patterns.email: Unless I hear otherwise by 3 PM, I will sign the revised report.
patterns.spoken: If I don't hear back by 3, I'll go ahead and sign.

source: 메일 조회 불가(Graph 502)로 이번 주 업무 주제에서 직접 고름: 이전가격 보고서 수정본 서명, PR 승인 지연, 전기점검·CCTV 견적 비교, 미싱사 무기한 계약 전환.
